name: Halvek Guava-Rosehip Tonic
description: A small-batch tonic from a Tier 3-focused independent, using real rosehip extract and high-grade synth-guava in a lightly sweetened base. Sold in frosted glass bottles with a botanical illustration label.
flavor_profile: Soft guava sweetness layered with the floral tartness of rosehip, dry tonic finish with fine bubbles
cultural_context: Halvek sits at the premium-independent tier — expensive enough to feel special, accessible enough that Tier 3 professionals buy it without guilt. The real rosehip extract is prominently featured in the marketing as a mark of authenticity.
story_hooks: Halvek's rosehip supply comes from a single vertical farm in the northern corridor that has just been condemned for structural failure — the company has three months of stock left and no alternative supplier.

A Tier 5 collector has begun buying entire production runs of Halvek to serve exclusively at private events, effectively cutting off regular retail supply — and the scarcity is making it more desirable.
The botanical illustration on the Halvek label was stolen from a deceased artist's digital estate without proper licensing — her family has just discovered this and retained a legal advocate.
